label: DRT8 system
definition: A DRT system in which an organism possesses a genome-encoded DefenseFinder DRT8 subtype locus represented by a mandatory DRT8__DRT8 profile, optionally accompanied by the DRT8__DRT8b accessory profile.
observations: DRT8 branch under DRT system; distinct from the broader DRT system, the individual DRT8 reverse-transcriptase profile rows, unresolved DRT8 phage triggers, direct RT products, host breadth, accessory profiles, and other DRT subtypes.
